title: 第320章 师兄哪吒16不就是多看了他媳妇两眼吗第319章 师兄哪吒15姐姐我就要和你睡
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 这日，太乙真人不知从何处接下一桩除妖差事，当即大手一挥，将哪吒与江盼一并打发出门。
“徒儿，也该出门历练历练了。
顺带——”
他凑到哪吒身侧，压低声音嘱咐道，“替为师捎回两只烧鸡，陈塘关东市林家铺子的桂花酿，也别忘了带上。”
“上回整只烧鸡都进了你的肚子，贫道半口都没尝到。
那坛桂花酿又被你长寿师叔偷喝大半，如今想来，依旧心疼不已。”
哪吒面无表情地望着他：“师父，我们是前去除妖的。”
太乙理直气壮：“除妖和捎带吃食，本就互不冲突。”
哪吒懒得再多言，拉起江盼的手转身就走。
身后很快传来太乙高声的呼喊：“烧鸡要江家的！
桂花酿得选坛底的！
千万记牢了——”
哪吒走得更快了。
陈塘关的集市，依旧一派热闹喧嚣。
江盼走在前头，哪吒紧随其后，始终落后半步。
这个距离拿捏得十分微妙，不远不近，既能将江盼的身影完完整整收进眼底，也能把所有投向她的目光，一一尽收眼中。
江盼对此毫无察觉，视线早已被街边的糖葫芦摊吸引。
鲜红的山楂串在竹签上，裹着一层晶莹剔透的糖衣，在日光下泛着诱人的光泽。
她忍不住多看了几眼。
守摊的中年汉子见有客人驻足，立刻热情招呼：“姑娘，来一串尝尝？刚熬好的糖，新鲜着呢！”
不等江盼开口，他又上下打量她一番，笑呵呵补充道：“姑娘生得这般好看，我这糖葫芦配着你，都添了几分贵气。”
江盼被夸得有些不好意思，正准备掏钱，摊主的脸色却骤然一变。
笑意瞬间僵在脸上，瞳孔猛地收缩，嘴巴张了张，愣是半个字也没能发出。
他像是撞见了什么极度可怖的事物，二话不说，连摊子都顾不上，转身拔腿狂奔，片刻间便跑得无影无踪。
江盼愣在原地：“……哎？你的摊子还在呢——”
她茫然转头，看向身后的哪吒。
少年立在暖阳之下，眉眼温润，唇角噙着浅浅笑意，模样乖巧干净，和平日里别无二致。
“姐姐，我想吃糖葫芦。”
软糯的嗓音裹着几分撒娇的尾音。
江盼盯着他看了两秒，看不出半点异样。
可方才那一瞬间，她分明捕捉到一缕莫名的寒意，如同鬼魅般在暗处一闪而逝。
哪吒微微歪头，眼神纯良，一脸无辜。
江盼甩了甩脑中纷乱的念头，压下心底的疑虑：“好，我去买，你等着。”
摊主早已逃走，只剩一串串糖葫芦留在案板上。
江盼放下几枚铜钱，拿起两串，递了一串给哪吒，自己留了一串。
哪吒接过糖葫芦，却迟迟没有入口，只是静静抬眸望着她。
江盼咬下一颗山楂，酸甜的滋味在舌尖化开，她惬意地眯起了眼。
“姐姐，好吃吗？”
“可好吃了，你也尝尝。”
content_en:
On this day, Master Taiyi didn't know where he picked up the task of exterminating demons. He immediately sent Nezha and Jiang Pan out of the house with a wave of his hand.
“Disciple, it’s time to go out and practice.
By the way——"
He leaned close to Nezha and asked in a low voice, "Bring back two roast chickens for my master, and don't forget to bring the sweet-scented osmanthus wine from Linjiapu in Guandong City, Chentang."
"Last time, the whole roast chicken went into your stomach, and I didn't even taste half of it.
Your uncle Changshou secretly drank most of that jar of sweet-scented osmanthus wine. Now that I think about it, I still feel heartbroken. "
Nezha looked at him expressionlessly: "Master, we are here to slay the demons."
Taiyi said confidently: "Exterminating demons and eating food along the way do not conflict with each other."
Nezha was too lazy to say anything more, so he took Jiang Pan's hand and turned around to leave.
Taiyi’s loud shout soon came from behind: “I want the roast chicken from the Jiang family!
The sweet-scented osmanthus must be brewed at the bottom of the altar!
Be sure to remember-"
Nezha walked faster.
The market in Chentangguan is still lively and noisy.
Jiang Pan walked in front, followed closely by Nezha, always half a step behind.
This distance was chosen very subtly, neither too far nor too close. It could not only take Jiang Pan's figure completely into her eyes, but also catch all the eyes directed at her.
Jiang Pan didn't notice this at all, his eyes had already been attracted by the candied haws stall on the street.
Bright red hawthorns are strung on bamboo sticks and wrapped in a layer of crystal clear sugar coating, glowing with an attractive luster in the sun.
She couldn't help but take a few more glances.
When the middle-aged man guarding the stall saw a customer stopping by, he immediately greeted him warmly: "Girl, would you like to try a bunch? The candy has just been boiled, it's fresh!"
Before Jiang Pan could speak, he looked her up and down again, and added with a smile: "The girl is so beautiful, and my candied haws on you, it adds a bit of nobility."
Jiang Pan was a little embarrassed by the praise and was about to pay when the stall owner's expression suddenly changed.
The smile froze on his face for an instant, his pupils shrank suddenly, his mouth opened, but not even a single word came out.
He seemed to have encountered something extremely terrifying. Without saying a word and not even paying attention to the stall, he turned around and ran away without a trace in a moment.
Jiang Pan froze on the spot: "...Huh? Your stall is still there -"
She turned her head blankly and looked at Nezha behind her.
The young man stood under the warm sun, with warm eyebrows and a slight smile on his lips. He looked well-behaved and clean, just like usual.
"Sister, I want to eat candied haws on a stick."
The soft and waxy voice is wrapped in a bit of coquettish ending.
Jiang Pan stared at him for two seconds, unable to see anything strange.
But at that moment, she clearly caught an inexplicable chill, flashing in the dark like a ghost.
"...sister?"
Nezha tilted his head slightly, his eyes were pure and his face was innocent.
Jiang Pan shook off the chaotic thoughts in his mind and suppressed the doubts in his heart: "Okay, I'll buy it, you wait."
The stall owner had already fled, leaving only bunches of candied haws on the chopping board.
Jiang Pan put down a few copper coins, picked up two bunches, handed one bunch to Nezha, and kept one bunch for himself.
Nezha took the candied haws of apples, but he didn't enter for a long time. He just looked up at her quietly.
Jiang Pan bit down a hawthorn, and the sweet and sour taste melted on her tongue. She narrowed her eyes in contentment.
"Sister, is it delicious?"
"It's delicious, you should try it too."
